issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 md 猜成 45f，改版前视频只有浮现段，翻色这个唯一爆点根本没演到
图标是 44px 裸字形散在纯白底上，像一张图标字体表，不像“功能宇宙”
浮现批次纯随机，满屏零碎闪现，没有方向
四道色波是高饱和的蓝/橙/绿/红，色带死平；两色交替时半透明叠出浑浊的中间色
整场偏上（上边距 26、下边距 20），纯白底没有层次
changes: 导出 ICON_FIELD_COLORIZE_DURATION = 150（浮现 ~50f + 静置 + 翻色 ~42f + 终态 hold 1s）
图标装进 60px 的 app 图标式圆角方块：灰阶态是浅灰磨砂底加冷灰字形；点亮态是品牌色渐变底、白字形、内高光加同色投影，翻色读作“整块被点亮”
浮现批次按离中心距离（70%）加噪声（30%）分组，读作从中心向外铺开；入场改为 overshoot 微弹，同时上浮 10px
色板换成克制的靛 / 琥珀 / 青绿 / 珊瑚，同色带内 ±4% 明度微差；新色层 1.5f 内盖满，不出浑色；保留行差 1.4f 的波纹和 1.22x 翻色 pop
整场按格距居中，边距均匀；柔光浅底加极淡暗角和颗粒，全程 smooth 曲线极缓推近 2.5%
issuesEn: No exported duration constant: the workbench guessed 45f from the md, so the before video shows only the fade-in and never reaches the colorize payoff
Icons were bare 44px glyphs on pure white, reading like an icon-font specimen rather than a feature universe
Fade-in batches were purely random, giving scattered flicker with no direction
The four waves were saturated blue/orange/green/red bands with flat color, and crossfades between colors produced muddy intermediates
The field sat high (26px top margin vs 20px bottom) on a flat white background
changesEn: Exported ICON_FIELD_COLORIZE_DURATION = 150 (~50f fade-in + rest + ~42f colorize + 1s final hold)

Icons now sit in 60px app-icon style rounded tiles: the gray state is a frosted light-gray tile with a cool-gray glyph; the lit state is a brand-color gradient tile with a white glyph, inner highlight and same-hue shadow, so the colorize reads as whole tiles lighting up
Fade-in batches are grouped by distance from center (70%) plus noise (30%), so the field blooms outward; the entrance uses an overshoot pop with a 10px rise

The palette is now a restrained indigo / amber / teal / coral with ±4% lightness variation within each band; the new color covers fully within 1.5f to avoid mud; the 1.4f row-stagger wave and 1.22x pop are kept
The field is centered on its grid with even margins; soft light background with faint vignette and grain, plus a slow 2.5% push-in on a smooth curve
